resources.string: You can turn AI off again any time in Settings.
Quick add still works on this phone. With AI on, Google Gemini also reads bills, statements and what you say, and answers questions about your month. You check every entry before it\'s saved.
AI is off, so this photo stayed on your phone. Turn it on and Google Gemini reads the bill to fill in the amount, the place and the date. You check it before saving.
Type it myself, keep the photo
AI is off, so the statement stayed on your phone. Turn it on and Google Gemini picks out each payment, and you tick the ones to add.
AI is off, so nothing you say is recorded or sent. Turn it on and Google Gemini turns what you say into an entry, ready for you to check.
AI is off, so your month stayed on your phone. Turn it on and Google Gemini answers from this month\'s entries.
The trip review is written by AI
AI is off, so this group stayed on your phone. Turn it on and Google Gemini writes a short review of the trip from its expenses.
